text:
[Council File 25-0774; CD 15]
Department of City Planning (DCP) Report with Revised Recommended Actions, DCP Supplemental Report, and Zoning Code Maps relative to the Wilmington-Harbor City Community Plan Update located in the far southern portion of the City, near Los Angeles Harbor, it is bordered by the Harbor Gateway Community Plan Area (CPA) to the north, the San Pedro CPA and the Port of Los Angeles to the south, and is adjacent to the cities of Torrance, Lomita, and Rancho Palos Verdes to the west; and the cities of Carson, Long Beach, and unincorporated Los Angeles County to the east.
Applicant: City of Los Angeles
Case No. CPC-2018-6402-CPU
Environmental No. ENV-2019-3379-EIR
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Update Community Plan for Wilmington-Harbor City area in southern Los Angeles near Los Angeles Harbor.

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Sep 22, 2026)
